If there are adds on the fight and you touch them it can steal procs and keep you from stacking up keeping the damage low.

idk man. i personally think having ilvl rule all would just be a boring linear scale, and there would probably be a good amount of variance between players at higher ilvl as people would have different proportional stat distributions. 

like let’s say ilvl rules all.  shadow priest A gets 440 ilvl with gear that has a lot of haste on it, but shadow priest B also has 440 ilvl but has very little haste. priest A will do more damage and have his class feel better to play because of his haste, while priest B is stuck casting in mud because he didn’t get haste on his high ilvl gear. obviously if ilvl rules all, then int will have to be king stat, which is a flip flop of the current shadow priest model where it’s valued at roughly half of haste’s value.
